title: Lovely Garlicky Spanish Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Andalusian-inspired stew featuring Hispi sweetheart cabbage, garlic, and spices, made in one pot and dehydrated for a tamasic-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook for 5 minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Use a dehydrator or your oven on the lowest temperature setting to dehydrate the stew for 2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
